mstts:express-as.prosody: Imagine living in a world where almost every move you make—online or off—might leave a trace. A world shaped by digital footprints and silent surveillance, where the line between privacy and intrusion blurs just a little bit more each day. That’s the landscape we’ll be exploring together, guided by the extraordinary story found in Permanent Record, written by Edward Snowden. Now, this isn’t just a tale about technology or secret codes. It’s about the tough moral choices that ripple through our lives—choices that don’t just shape one person, but can shift the course of entire societies. As we follow Snowden’s journey—from the hidden halls of intelligence agencies out onto the world stage—we’ll find ourselves wrestling with questions about freedom, loyalty, and the real meaning of privacy. What happens when someone decides to challenge the status quo, even if it means risking everything? And how much of ourselves do we give up, often without knowing, in the name of security? Together, we’ll peel back the layers of the surveillance culture that quietly surrounds us, and reflect on what it truly costs to stand up for the truth. So, get ready to dive deep into the heart of the digital age, and let’s discover what it really means to protect our autonomy in a world that’s always watching.
